primary_pass: Answers the actual request using sufficient source-supported information, with no material unsupported claim about the meeting or requested task. Optional reference details are not mandatory keywords.
controls: DailyTalk runtime controls and selected-source text controls remain separate from the three main text conditions and six distinct question count.
candidate: Native S1 text per user instruction; final S2 answer text. No response ASR is used. Native text is not proof of audible speech.
window: The whole captured response is reviewed; unfinished final packets are flagged. Any shorter-window follow-up is a separately labeled diagnostic, not a replacement attempt.

required: Identify D as the earlier volunteer, using an appropriate speaker identifier or a genuinely identifying description.
optional: Exact quote or a personal name that the source does not supply.
pilot:P-EN-notes.caveat: Anonymous speaker letters are supplied in text-oracle inputs but are not spoken in S1 audio. Do not require an unavailable personal name; flag unresolved identity mapping separately.

required: Give a recorded reason for dropping the work: insufficient time, not knowing how to approach it, or higher-priority work.
optional: Mentioning every one of the three reasons.
avoid: Inventing a completed implementation, technical impossibility or an unrecorded cost.

required: The choice between printing the slogan and embodying its idea remained unresolved.
optional: Naming B or D or quoting the long-slogan concern.
avoid: Claiming a settled print-only or idea-only decision.

optional: Forty minutes overall for presentations and discussion.
avoid: Replacing the per-presentation allowance with the total meeting allocation.

required: The speaker who volunteered to send the main call (A in the transcript) would do so today or tomorrow.
Claire could handle Psychology; her appropriate address, relevance or being known to recipients explains the separate message.
optional: All three rationale details or the words Linguistics and English Language.
avoid: Using the earlier end-of-week statement as the latest timing.
first:authored-W1-2.caveat: Speaker identifiers are oracle labels in text input; unavailable personal names are not required.

required: Report that C said the files were put in the shared folder, with uncertainty/current-visibility limits rather than a claimed live check.
optional: D initially saw only their own presentation; the components-design PowerPoint identity.
avoid: A general outage, failed upload, completed assistant check or verified universal access not established by speech.

automatic_identity_scoring: Accept an anonymous speaker label when it identifies the reference speaker under the past-only annotation mapping used solely for evaluation. An unknown requester or an unknown referenced owner is not silently filled from annotations in the model input.
